title: Implementation of Digital Twin Technology for Port Operations
scope_summary: JNPA has floated a tender on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for the implementation of a Digital Twin project. This initiative aims to create a virtual replica of the port's physical assets, processes, and systems for real-time monitoring, predictive analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

title: Monitoring Infrastructure Projects using IDDP (Integrated Digital Delivery Platform) for MMRDA
scope_summary: MMRDA is implementing an Integrated Digital Delivery Platform (IDDP) to manage Metro and Infrastructure construction projects. This involves leveraging BIM, GIS integration, 5D BIM, drone technology, and ERP integration for enhanced data management, collaboration, visualization, and efficient monitoring.

title: Artificial Intelligence Enabled Condition Based Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance of AFV Engine
scope_summary: This tender seeks solutions for AI-enabled condition-based monitoring and predictive maintenance for Armoured Fighting Vehicle (AFV) engines. The scope includes deploying AI/ML technologies to predict potential engine failures and optimize maintenance schedules.
